message:
Blog slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes, all 3 tests.

The cause was the vendored `slugify`, which strips anything outside `a-z0-9`, so "è" and "û" were dropped. `vendor/` is off-limits, so I fixed it in `src/blog/slug.js` instead. `postSlug` now strips the accent marks before calling `slugify`.

Shop product URLs (`src/shop/product-url.js`) call `slugify` directly, so they still drop accented letters. I left them alone since you only asked about blog posts. Say if you want the same fix there.
